description:
Rotate a ring. Match three petals. Watch the garden bloom.

Ringbloom is a calm rotational puzzle with a simple choice behind every move: select the inner, middle or outer ring, then turn it left or right. Align matching petals across a spoke, make a bloom and keep your garden growing before your moves run out.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

• Garden — an endless, steadily growing puzzle for a quick break or a longer run.
• Flower Show — focused Classes with fresh objectives and new ways to think about each turn.

Start free with endless Garden and the first five Flower Show Classes. When you want a bigger challenge, one permanent purchase unlocks 25 more campaign Classes and the Champion Circuit. There is no subscription, energy system or advertising.

Build bloom chains, chase stronger results and replay Classes to improve your rating. Clear objectives arrive as you play, with labelled controls, Undo and Hint support when you need a hand.

Ringbloom is designed for one-thumb play, with distinct glyphs alongside colour, VoiceOver support, Larger Text layouts and Reduce Motion support. Gameplay works offline and progress is kept on your device.

Ringbloom began as an AI app-building benchmark and has been refined through play and testing.

Ringbloom uses limited analytics and advertising attribution. No account is required. See the privacy policy for the information used and the choices available.
whatsNew:

promotionalText: Rotate. Match. Bloom. Play endless Garden and five Flower Show Classes free. No ads. Unlock 25 more Classes and the Champion Circuit with one permanent purchase.
